rules.title: Sharp librsvg memory vulnerability

preconditions.description: The documented possible RCE conditions include glibc-based Linux; platform absence does not establish absence of the memory bug.
SVG decoding is enabled in the deployed Sharp process.
The deployed Node executable lacks PIE, the documented RCE mitigation.
Operator review indicates an untrusted SVG input path; this tool does not test data flow or reachability.

mitigations.description: Effective blocking of VipsForeignLoadSvg prevents Sharp SVG decoding; source text alone is insufficient.
Node PIE mitigates the documented RCE condition; it does not establish library patch state or remove other memory-corruption impact.

notes: Maintainer advisory: Sharp <0.35.5; patched >=0.35.5. The shipped snapshot restricts future comparison to the reviewed 0.35 release line and older 0.x versions.
Sharp 0.35.5 provides librsvg 2.63.2 in its official prebuilt binaries. Custom and global linkage require independent evidence.

The advisory names librsvg 2.63.2 remediation but publishes no separate librsvg affected-range lower bound. Older global librsvg remains unknown requiring remediation review; only stable 2.63.2+ in the 2.63 line is accepted as reported remediation.
The GitHub database patched-version header says 0.35.5; its description agrees with the maintainer. The maintainer's >=0.35.5 statement governs the bundled comparison.
Every assessment is operator-reported evidence. Exploitability and reachability remain not_tested.
